text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: PROD_INFERENCE_QUEUE_HIGH. queue backlog > 5k for inference-cell-us-east-1. autoscaler lagging. PD: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-17412 assigned to @oncall-eng

alice.nguyen: acked. I'm looking at metrics and events now.

ben_m: seeing K8s events -> `HorizontalPodAutoscaler` backoff, cloud provider rate-limit on node provisioning. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/inference/queue-backlog

samira: can we try a manual scale to buy time? `kubectl scale deployment inference-cell-340 -n prod --replicas=8`

jordan: doing manual scale now to 8 replicas. watching queue and pod readiness.

ops-bot: scale action started by jordan: scaling inference-cell-340 -> 8 replicas. CI job id: scale-1741209876-1

alice.nguyen: nodes are slow to come up due to spot allocation failures; cloud quota appears near limit for pGPU. taking steps to free capacity in cloud console.

ben_m: temporary mitigation: enabling tenant-level rate-limiter on the edge for non-critical tenants to reduce incoming RPS by ~30%. will monitor queue drain.

samira: enabled rate-limiter rule `ratelimit:tenant.noncritical=0.7` via infra API. curl POST: `https://api.redwood/internal/ratelimit` (audit id rl-1741209876).

incident-bot: PagerDuty: assigned -> alice.nguyen. escalation timer paused.

jordan: queue length falling: 5200 -> 2100 in 4m after scale + rate-limit. pods ready: 7/8.

alice.nguyen: freed some spot capacity (terminated stale test pools), starting nodepool add for on-demand fallback. ETA ~3m for nodes to register.

ben_m: filing follow-up: INF-987 to investigate autoscaler cold-start/warmup and kv-cache prewarm. suggests lowering cooldown and prewarming KV on rollout.

samira: adding runbook note and tagging PR with recommended autoscaler tweaks. :thumbsup:

alice.nguyen: Support update: CS reports isolated 5xxs for a small set of tenants during peak backlog. Not a global outage. notifying affected customers.

jordan: if queue < 500 for 10m we can close the PD. continuing to monitor.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: will auto-check in 10m for closure conditions.
